title: Practice check: SQLite LeetCode format
description: Fixture for sqlite options: last result set, checkColumnNames, floatTolerance, checkQuery, REGEXP, params convention, math. Every starterCode must fail.

steps.title: Second Highest Salary (temp table, NULL row)

content.description: Верните второй по величине уникальный оклад как `SecondHighestSalary`; если его нет — `NULL`.
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employee(id INT PRIMARY KEY, salary INT);
content.starterCode: SELECT salary AS SecondHighestSalary FROM Employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;
content.referenceSolution:
CREATE TEMP TABLE distinct_salaries AS SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM Employee;
SELECT (SELECT salary FROM distinct_salaries ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS SecondHighestSalary;

content.description: Для каждого человека выведите `firstName`, `lastName`, `city`, `state`; адреса может не быть.
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Person(personId INT PRIMARY KEY, lastName TEXT, firstName TEXT);
CREATE TABLE Address(addressId INT PRIMARY KEY, personId INT, city TEXT, state TEXT);
content.starterCode: SELECT p.firstName AS first_name, p.lastName, a.city, a.state FROM Person p LEFT JOIN Address a ON p.personId = a.personId;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT p.firstName, p.lastName, a.city, a.state FROM Person p LEFT JOIN Address a ON p.personId = a.personId;

content.setup: CREATE TABLE Sales(product_id INT, price INT);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, SUM(price) / COUNT(*) AS average_price FROM Sales GROUP BY product_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT product_id, ROUND(AVG(price * 1.0), 4) AS average_price FROM Sales GROUP BY product_id;

content.description: Удалите дубликаты email, оставив строку с наименьшим `id`.
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Person(id INT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT);
content.referenceSolution: DELETE FROM Person WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM Person GROUP BY email);
content.checkQuery: SELECT id, email FROM Person ORDER BY id;

content.description: Пациенты, у которых есть код, начинающийся с `DIAB1` (коды разделены пробелами).
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Patients(patient_id INT PRIMARY KEY, patient_name TEXT, conditions TEXT);
content.starterCode: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, conditions FROM Patients WHERE conditions LIKE '%DIAB1%';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, conditions FROM Patients WHERE conditions REGEXP '(^| )DIAB1';

content.description: Верните N-й по величине уникальный оклад как `getNthHighestSalary`; N лежит в таблице `params(n)`.
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Employee(id INT PRIMARY KEY, salary INT);
CREATE TABLE params(n INT);
content.starterCode: SELECT MAX(salary) AS getNthHighestSalary FROM Employee;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM Employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT n - 1 FROM params)) AS getNthHighestSalary;

content.description: Кратчайшее расстояние между двумя разными точками, округлённое до 2 знаков, как `shortest`.
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Point2D(x INT, y INT);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(MIN(SQRT(POW(a.x - b.x, 2) + POW(a.y - b.y, 2))), 2) AS shortest FROM Point2D a JOIN Point2D b ON a.x <> b.x OR a.y <> b.y;
